acceptanceCriteria: Row carries samePathCitations and a diff-adjacent-base count; the three retained baselines are re-emitted with the new members and the build-log entries record the self-citation share.
body:
Panel finding (adversary and eval-method lenses). tools/cem-citation-baseline/main.go:199-212 writes the row without samePathCitations; `grep -c samePathCitations docs/build-log/evidence/v1-1281/citation-baseline-maps.jsonl` is 0 (same for v1-1262, v1-1277).
Expected: the retained corpus measure exposes maps whose bases are the hunk's own file (CEM-V1-082 defines the member for this).
Actual: the newest sealed map 03a8ca10 verifies ACCEPT with samePathCitations 439/445 and anchored 0, and 860f59ea has 152/156 same-file bases with 148 within 3 lines of the hunk's own old range; neither is visible in the rows. The 15 maps after the V1-1281 baseline cite the same path for 62% of bases (historical 8.5%).

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: cem-citation-baseline rows omit samePathCitations, so self-citation is invisible in every recorded baseline
